1eb65c09da43b06c: Tokens: woh units jo model padhta hai
23e94cb30927ad5e: Language model letters ya poore words ko waise nahi dekhta jaise aap dekhte hain. Text pehle tokens mein toota hai, jo common chunks hote hain jaise chhota word, lambe word ka hissa, ya punctuation mark. Har token ek number se map hota hai, aur model sirf in numbers ke saath kaam karta hai. Isi wajah se models ko word mein letters ginne jaise kaamon mein dikkat ho sakti hai, kyunki letters ek hi token ke andar chhupe ho sakte hain. AI services ki prices aur limits aam taur par words mein nahi, tokens mein measure hoti hain.
bd076bb82202eb61: Asal mein large language model ek hi kaam karta hai: tokens ki ek sequence di jaaye toh woh estimate karta hai ki har possible agla token kitna likely hai. Woh ek chunta hai, use sequence mein jodta hai, aur rukne tak yahi process repeat karta hai. Lambe answers, code aur summaries sab isi simple loop se aate hain. Temperature naam ki setting control karti hai ki choice kitni adventurous ho; low values sabse likely token ko favour karti hain aur higher values variety jodti hain. Is dauraan model kisi database mein facts look up nahi kar raha hota, woh aisa text bana raha hota hai jo uske seekhe patterns mein fit ho.
44d942aa2c364141: Training woh mehenga phase hai jismein model seekhta hai. Pretraining ke dauraan model bahut bada text padhta hai aur baar-baar apne internal numbers, jinhe weights ya parameters kehte hain, adjust karta hai taaki agla token behtar predict kar sake. Baad ke stages, jaise curated examples par fine-tuning aur human feedback se seekhna, model ko ek helpful assistant banate hain. Training ke liye bahut zyada computing power aur data chahiye, aur yeh model release hone se pehle hoti hai. Training khatam hone par model ki knowledge ek point in time par fix ho jaati hai, jise aksar knowledge cutoff kehte hain.
3a52ddddfd05d43a: Inference woh hai jo har baar hota hai jab koi model ko prompt bhejta hai aur woh reply generate karta hai. Inference ke dauraan weights nahi badalte, isliye ek conversation model ko retrain nahi karti. Reply ke liye model jo kuch consider kar sakta hai, sab uski context window mein fit hona chahiye, jo tokens ki woh maximum sankhya hai jo woh ek saath process kar sakta hai. Applications aksar user ke message se pehle context mein extra text jodti hain, jaise instructions, documents ya search results. Inference per request training se kaafi sasta hai, lekin millions of requests mein yeh kharcha jud jaata hai.
932db5e340689fc9: Hallucination aisa output hai jo confident aur fluent lagta hai lekin galat ya banaya hua hota hai, jaise fake citation ya galat contract address. Yeh isliye hota hai kyunki model plausible text banane ke liye optimize hota hai, aur plausible lagne wala answer hamesha sahi nahi hota. Model ke paas yeh jaanne ka koi built-in tareeka nahi ki woh sach mein kuch jaanta hai ya nahi. Rare facts, exact numbers aur knowledge cutoff ke baad ke events mein hallucination ka chance zyada hota hai. Crypto mein, jahan ek galat address ya number se funds kho sakte hain, model ka koi bhi important output kisi reliable source se check karna chahiye.
41aefc7f9023e832: Yeh basics aapko marketing claims judge karne ka toolkit dete hain. Agar koi project kahe ki uska model on-chain train hua, toh poochiye ki asal mein kya train hua, kahan, aur kis compute se, kyunki bade models train karna bahut resource-intensive hai. Agar koi product kahe ki uska AI galti nahi kar sakta, toh aap pehle se jaante hain ki fluent output bhi galat ho sakta hai. Allowlist restrict karti hai ki woh kin contracts ya addresses se interact kar sakta hai, taaki kehne par bhi woh kisi unknown address par funds na bhej sake. Smart account ek session key issue kar sakta hai: ek alag key jo sirf kuch contracts, amounts aur time windows ke liye valid hoti hai. Agent session key rakhta hai, jabki owner ki main key offline rehti hai. Kyunki limits account contract on-chain check karta hai, woh tab bhi kaayam rehti hain jab agent ka software poori tarah compromise ho jaaye.

Traditional cloud providers yeh hardware rent karte hain, lekin pricing aur access kuch badi companies tay karti hain. bfe842fa92bd5969: Akash Cosmos SDK se bana ek general-purpose decentralized cloud hai. Tenant ek bid chunta hai, jisse lease banti hai, aur lease chalne tak escrow account se provider ko payments jaate hain. Render burn-and-mint model use karta hai: users kaam ke liye tokens se pay karte hain jo burn ho jaate hain, aur node operators ko naye mint hue tokens se reward milta hai. Idea yeh hai ki token supply mein badlav ko network ke asli use se joda jaaye. 5e649f039b85ab53: AI ke liye data provenance kyun matter karta hai
9edf0fb4cdbd07c6: Model ka behavior us data se banta hai jis par woh train hua, isliye us data ke sawaal matter karte hain. Kya woh licensed tha, kya consent se collect hua, aur kya usse chhed-chhaad hui? Model weights bhi bas files hain, aur ek hi naam wali do files mein bilkul alag models ho sakte hain. Provenance ka matlab hai ek verifiable record ki koi cheez kahan se aayi aur uske saath kya hua. Iske bina users ko provider ki baat par bharosa karna padta hai ki unhe kaun sa data aur kaun sa model mil raha hai.
85f0721e42bbd42d: Cryptographic hash kisi bhi file ko ek chhote fingerprint mein badal deta hai, aur file ka ek bit bhi badalne se fingerprint poori tarah badal jaata hai. Content addressing is fingerprint ko file ka address banata hai, taaki aap data ko is basis par maangein ki woh kya hai, na ki kahan stored hai. IPFS aise hi kaam karta hai, content ko content identifier yaani CID se pehchanta hai, jo hash se banta hai. Agar aapko kisi dataset ya model weights ka CID pata hai, toh aap check kar sakte hain ki download ki hui copy bilkul sahi wali hai. Content addressing integrity prove karta hai, lekin akele yeh guarantee nahi deta ki koi data ko store karta rahega.
027621829d35dbc5: IPFS nodes sirf woh data rakhte hain jo woh rakhna chunte hain, jise aksar pinning kehte hain, isliye koi pin na kare toh files gayab ho sakti hain. Filecoin ek market jodta hai jahan clients storage providers ko data rakhne ke liye pay karte hain, aur providers ko cryptographic proofs submit karne padte hain. Proof-of-replication dikhata hai ki provider ne ek unique copy store ki, aur proof-of-spacetime dikhata hai ki woh samay ke saath use store karta raha, aur proofs fail hone par collateral risk mein hota hai. Arweave alag approach leta hai: ek baar ka upfront payment jo ek endowment ko fund karta hai, jo lambe samay tak storage ka kharcha uthane ke liye design hai. Trade-off mote taur par yeh hai: ongoing proofs wale renewable contracts banaam permanence ke liye ek single payment.
b71715cadceda289: Ek simple aur powerful pattern hai blockchain par hash publish karna. Agar team kisi transaction mein training dataset ya model weights ka hash post kare, toh baad mein koi bhi prove kar sakta hai ki file us block ke time tak bilkul usi form mein maujood thi. Aise records ki chain dikha sakti hai ki kaun se dataset version se kaun sa model version bana. Signatures identity jodte hain, jo dikhate hain ki kaun si key ne, aur isliye kaun si organization ne, har record publish kiya. Blockchain sirf chhote fingerprints store karta hai, jabki badi files storage networks ya normal servers par rehti hain.
15407149f95a8db6: AI se bani images, audio aur video ki wajah se yeh jaanna mushkil ho gaya hai ki media kahan se aaya. C2PA standard, jiska user-facing naam Content Credentials hai, media file ke saath ek signed manifest jodta hai jo facts record karta hai, jaise kis tool ne use banaya ya edit kiya. Verifier signature check karke confirm kar sakta hai ki file manifest ke description se match karti hai. Specification khud kehti hai ki yeh dikhata hai ki provenance data intact aur untampered hai ya nahi, yeh nahi ki content sach hai. Bina credentials wali file fake prove nahi hoti, bas uske paas verifiable provenance nahi hota.
ba9b620e56e8bdd4: Provenance kya fix nahi kar sakta
e1442fe9b232a6b5: On-chain hash prove karta hai ki file badli nahi, yeh nahi ki file accurate, legal ya fair hai. Blockchain par anchor kiya garbage data bhi garbage hi hai, bas provably unchanged garbage. Data poisoning, jahan attacker training data mein misleading examples ghusa deta hai, provenance system mein bilkul sahi record ho sakti hai bina pakde gaye. Licensing aur consent legal aur social sawaal hain jinka jawab hash nahi de sakta. Provenance ko quality ki guarantee ki jagah claims ko checkable banane ka tareeka samajhna behtar hai, taaki responsibility trace ki ja sake.

a52e1970f7b9a724: zkML machine learning par zero-knowledge proofs lagata hai. Model ki computation ek circuit ke roop mein likhi jaati hai, aur prover ek succinct proof banata hai ki committed model ko diye gaye input par chalane se ek specific output milta hai. Smart contract is proof ko sasta verify kar sakta hai, model dobara chalaye bina. Proof computation ke kuch hisse chhupa bhi sakta hai, jaise private model weights ya private inputs. Badi kami cost hai: proving normal model chalane se kahin zyada slow aur mehenga hai, aur model size ke saath yeh gap badhta hai, isliye bade models par zkML lagana sabse mushkil hai.

301a7c2ece452a17: Optimistic approaches, jinhe kabhi opML kehte hain, optimistic rollups ka design udhaar lete hain. Submitter result post karta hai aur woh default se accept ho jaata hai, lekin ek challenge period hota hai jismein koi bhi use dispute kar sakta hai. Dispute mein dono parties step by step apna disagreement chhota karti hain, jab tak ek chhota computation step on-chain check karke yeh tay na ho jaaye ki galat kaun tha. Normal operation sasta hai kyunki koi cheat na kare toh kuch extra nahi hota. Costs hain latency, kyunki results challenge period ke baad hi final hote hain, aur yeh assumption ki kam se kam ek honest party nazar rakh rahi hai aur challenge kar sakti hai.
980db14d02e86a01: Trusted execution environment, yaani TEE, processor ka ek isolated hissa hai jo aise design hai ki machine ka operator bhi andar chal rahi cheez ko na dekh sake na badal sake. Hardware ek signed attestation bana sakta hai jo batata hai ki exactly kaun sa code chal raha hai, aur result ek aisi key se sign ho sakta hai jo kabhi enclave se bahar nahi jaati. Verifier attestation ko hardware vendor ke certificates se check karta hai. Yeh fast hai aur overhead kam jodta hai, isliye bade models handle kar sakta hai. Trade-off hardware manufacturer par trust hai, aur TEEs par pichhle side-channel attacks dikhate hain ki attestation koi unconditional guarantee nahi hai.
5e8e38f9fc0c85e2: zkML sabse mazboot guarantee deta hai kyunki yeh mathematics par tika hai, lekin prove karne mein yeh sabse mehenga aur sabse slow hai. Optimistic verification normal case mein sasta hai lekin finalize hone mein slow hai aur un active watchers par nirbhar hai jinke paas challenge karne ka incentive ho. TEEs fast hain aur bade models ke liye practical hain, lekin trust ko chip vendor aur uske security record par shift kar dete hain. Kuch designs inhe jodte hain, jaise speed ke liye TEEs aur fallback ke liye optimistic ya zero-knowledge. Sahi choice is par depend karti hai ki output par kitni value tiki hai aur use kitni jaldi final hona chahiye.
820eb2d635c2be6b: Verification aam taur par maanta hai ki same model aur input hamesha same output denge. Practice mein GPUs par floating-point arithmetic hardware aur operations ke order ke hisaab se chhote-chhote farq de sakta hai. Temperature jaisi sampling settings bhi randomness jodti hain jab tak random seed fix na ho. Agar honest parties exact output par sahmat na ho sakein, toh optimistic disputes aur redundant execution toot jaate hain. Isliye kai verifiable inference designs deterministic arithmetic use karte hain, jaise fixed-point ya quantized numbers, speed ya accuracy ki thodi keemat par.

0655948255c77c8f: Prompt injection ek attack hai jismein koi aisa text banata hai jisse model apne instructions chhodkar attacker ke instructions follow karne lage. Direct injection mein attacker malicious instructions seedhe chat mein type karta hai. Indirect prompt injection agents ke liye zyada khatarnak hai: attacker instructions aise content mein chhupata hai jo agent baad mein padhega, jaise web page, email, social media post ya token ka metadata. Kyunki language model instructions aur data ko tokens ki ek hi stream ki tarah padhta hai, woh unhe reliably alag nahi kar sakta. Model level par koi poora known defense nahi hai, isliye defenses model ke aas-paas banane padte hain.
87bb1a17f1895cc3: Value rakhne wale agents ko bachana
72dfe67a931050bf: Core rule yeh hai ki model output akele kabhi authorization nahi hota. Value move karne wala har action aise checks se guzarna chahiye jinhe model override na kar sake, jaise on-chain spending limits, allowlists aur time-bound session keys. High-value ya unusual actions ke liye human confirmation zaroori hona chahiye, aur transactions ko pehle simulate karke unke asli effects dekhe ja sakte hain. Roles alag karna bhi madad karta hai: jo agent untrusted content padhta hai, woh wahi component nahi hona chahiye jiske paas signing authority ho. Maan kar chaliye ki attacker kabhi na kabhi model ke saamne text le aayega, aur aisa design kijiye ki sabse bura result bhi bounded rahe.
46d30bf92269e945: Bahut saare agent incidents seedhi-saadi key management failures hote hain. Environment variables, configuration files, code repositories ya logs mein rakhi private keys aam software bugs ya laaparwah sharing se leak ho sakti hain. Key ko kabhi model ke prompt ya context mein nahi rakhna chahiye, kyunki model use repeat kar sakta hai, aur context mein jo bhi hai woh injection se nikala ja sakta hai. Safer setups keys ko dedicated signing services, hardware security modules ya multi-party computation wallets mein rakhte hain jo sign karne se pehle policy enforce karte hain. Agents ke paas limited, revocable keys honi chahiye, jabki owner ki main keys pahunch se bahar rahein.
309c5f8a7896d317: Model outputs oracle data ki tarah
2645b7cdea712a16: Jab smart contract model ki kahi baat par act karta hai, toh model ek oracle ki tarah kaam kar raha hota hai, yaani bahar ka information source jise chain khud check nahi kar sakti. Oracle design ka har sabak yahan lagta hai: single sources kamzor hote hain, inputs manipulate ho sakte hain, aur source ko corrupt karne ke incentives daav par lagi value ke saath badhte hain. Model poisoned inputs se mod diya ja sakta hai, hallucinate kar sakta hai, aur jo use chalata hai woh chupchaap use kisi doosre model se badal sakta hai. Defenses mein verifiable inference, kai independent models ya providers ka use, outputs par sanity bounds, aur aise delays shaamil hain jo insaanon ko react karne ka samay dein. Output par jitni zyada value tiki ho, use utne zyada verification ki zaroorat hai.

Doosra, poochiye ki kya token ka koi zaroori role hai, jaise service ke liye pay karna, staking se network secure karna, ya governance, ya woh sirf fundraising ke liye juda hai. Teesra, poochiye ki model, keys aur upgrade rights kiske control mein hain, kyunki ek team ka chalaya autonomous agent bhi usi team ke control mein hai. d2c6e14d35a97ddc: October 2008 mein, Satoshi Nakamoto naam use karne wale ek vyakti ya group ne Bitcoin whitepaper publish kiya. Usme peer-to-peer electronic cash ka idea tha jo beech mein kisi bank ya payment company ke bina chalta hai. Network January 2009 mein live hua. Bitcoin ka main kaam simple hai: logon ko aisi value hold aur send karne dena jise koi akela party control nahi karti.
997c74e633741846: Ethereum ko Vitalik Buterin ne 2013 mein propose kiya aur 2015 mein launch hua. Ye Bitcoin ki tarah ek shared ledger rakhta hai, lekin saath mein smart contracts naam ke programs bhi chalata hai. Isliye ye tokens, exchanges aur lending markets jaise applications ka platform hai. Iska native coin, ether (ETH), us computation ki payment karta hai.
981e5cb437c73bb1: Bitcoin ki supply 21 million coins par capped hai, aur naye coins ki rate lagbhag har chaar saal mein aadhi ho jaati hai. Ethereum ka koi fixed cap nahi hai. 8aa20821c5c82b71: Bitcoin account balances store nahi karta. Ye unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) track karta hai, jo alag-alag size ke notes ki tarah kaam karte hain. Ek transaction poore UTXOs ko inputs ki tarah kharch karta hai aur naye outputs banata hai. Agar inputs payment se zyada ke hain, toh wallet baaki amount change output ki tarah khud ko wapas bhejta hai.
78bb0e92f9db9e74: Ethereum har account ka balance store karta hai, bilkul bank ledger ki tarah. Private keys se control hone wale externally owned accounts hote hain aur code se control hone wale contract accounts. Har account ka ek nonce hota hai, ek counter jo har bheje gaye transaction ke saath badhta hai. Nonce signed transaction ko replay hone se rokta hai aur account ke transactions ko order mein chalata hai.
faa3524a0e3e0a01: Bitcoin fee simply inputs ki value minus outputs ki value hai. Miners un transactions ko prefer karte hain jo block space ke har unit ke liye zyada pay karte hain, isliye fees satoshis per virtual byte mein batayi jaati hai. Zyada inputs wala transaction bada hota hai, isliye chhota amount bhejne par bhi uski cost zyada hoti hai.
b98a40d7e58cec65: Ethereum par har operation ki gas ki ek fixed cost hoti hai, aur aap used gas guna price per gas pay karte hain. Ek simple ETH transfer 21,000 gas use karta hai, jabki complex contract call kahin zyada use kar sakti hai. Agar transaction ki gas khatam ho jaaye, toh uske changes revert ho jaate hain lekin ho chuke kaam ki fee phir bhi lagti hai.

10b3183b075c46bd: Centralized exchange (CEX) par aap funds ek aise account mein deposit karte hain jise exchange control karta hai, aur trades exchange ke private systems mein match hote hain. Decentralized exchange (DEX) par aap self-custodial wallet se trade karte hain aur ek smart contract blockchain par swap execute karta hai. Tokens usi transaction mein aapke wallet se jaate aur aate hain, isliye na koi deposit step hai na kisi operator ke paas balance. Aapka wallet woh transaction dikhata hai aur aapse private key se sign karne ko kehta hai. Signed transaction network par broadcast hota hai, block mein include hone ka wait karta hai, aur phir ya toh poora execute hota hai ya revert ho jaata hai. Inclusion ke baad hi aapka wallet balance asal mein badalta hai.
a14a5ed4bdae0fbf: Har on-chain action computation use karta hai, aur aap iske liye chain ke native token mein gas fee pay karte hain. Swap revert ho sakta hai agar price aapki limit se aage chala jaaye, deadline nikal jaaye, ya aapke paas zaroori balance ya approval na ho. CEX par aap trading fees dete hain, lekin wallet mein withdraw karne par aksar network fee lagti hai. Kai interfaces convenience ke liye bahut bada ya unlimited approval suggest karte hain, jo baad mein gas bachata hai lekin ek standing permission chhod deta hai. Kuch MEV kaafi had tak useful hai, jaise arbitrage jo DEX prices ko baaki markets ke saath align karta hai, ya liquidations jo lending protocols ko solvent rakhte hain. d66402f86d22e949: Sandwich mein ek searcher aapka pending swap dekhta hai, aapse thik pehle wahi token khareedta hai (front-run) aur aapke thik baad bechta hai (back-run). Woh value user ke trade se bani thi, isliye kuch protection services back-run ka right auction karti hain aur kamai ka hissa user ko lautati hain. MEV Blocker ek aur RPC hai jo front-running aur sandwiching ko block karne ka lakshya rakhta hai, saath hi back-run rights ke liye searchers ke beech auction chalakar users ko rebate deta hai. Inhe use karne ke liye aap unka RPC endpoint apne wallet ki network settings mein jodte hain. Yeh services exposure kam karti hain lekin builders aur relays ke privacy maanne par nirbhar hain, isliye yeh guarantee nahi balki mitigation hain.

b8a6263346a88097: Lock-and-mint bridges source chain par tokens lock karte hain aur destination par wrapped version mint karte hain, isliye wrapped token utna hi safe hai jitna locked collateral aur bridge ka verification. Intent-based bridges flow ko ulta kar dete hain: user batata hai ki use kya milna chahiye, aur ek third party pehle apne funds se woh deliver karti hai. Agar deadline se pehle koi relayer fill nahi karta, toh user origin chain par deposit wapas le sakta hai. 8d75774be9f5bc0b: Perpetual future, yaani perp, ek contract hai jiski value kisi underlying asset, jaise BTC ya ETH, ke price ko track karti hai, bina trader ke us asset ko own kiye. Classic futures ki ek expiry date hoti hai jis din woh settle hote hain, aur yahi settlement unka price wapas spot price par laata hai. Perp ki koi expiry nahi hoti, isliye use ek alag anchor chahiye: longs aur shorts ke beech ek periodic payment jise funding kehte hain. Jab perp apne reference price se upar trade karta hai, longs shorts ko pay karte hain, aur jab neeche trade karta hai, shorts longs ko pay karte hain. Yeh lagaataar incentive contract price ko underlying market ke kareeb rakhta hai, jab tak position open rehti hai.
f04aaff3bd5aa855: Traders perps kyun use karte hain
dbc4c9310662efa5: Perps mein aap short utni hi aasaani se ja sakte hain jitna long, jo spot markets mein nahi hota. Inse aap chhote deposit, jise margin kehte hain, se badi position le sakte hain, aur yahi leverage ka matlab hai. Kyunki positions ek collateral asset mein settle hoti hain, aam taur par USDC jaisa stablecoin, aap har asset ko hold ya transfer kiye bina kai assets ka exposure le sakte hain. Perps hedging ke liye bhi use hote hain: koi token hold karne wala uska perp short karke bina beche apna exposure kam kar sakta hai. Jo features perps ko useful banate hain, wahi losses ko tez bhi laate hain, kyunki leverage losses ko bilkul waise hi badhata hai jaise gains ko.
781e68b56061a1a8: Perp exchange ko decentralized kya banata hai
69ddea1b694bbda2: Perpetual DEX par margin, matching, funding aur liquidation ke rules kisi company ke private database se nahi, balki smart contracts ya blockchain ki apni state machine se enforce hote hain. Users account mein login karne ke bajaye self-custody wallet connect karte hain aur signatures se actions authorize karte hain. Balances, open positions aur aksar order book bhi public ledger par dikhte hain, isliye koi bhi audit kar sakta hai ki exchange kya kar raha hai. Deposits ek contract ya bridge mein rehte hain jise operator apni marzi se kharch nahi kar sakta, haalaanki yeh guarantee kitni mazboot hai yeh design par nirbhar hai. Alag venues mein decentralization ka level bahut alag hota hai, aur ise maan lene ke bajaye check karna chahiye.
217d81a8d0aebb13: Perp DEX CEX se kaise alag hai
633482a4507977a8: Centralized exchange (CEX) aapke funds apne wallets mein rakhta hai aur aapka balance ek internal ledger mein track karta hai jise bahar wale dekh nahi sakte. Uska matching engine, liquidation logic aur risk parameters private hote hain, aur access ek account par nirbhar hai jise exchange freeze kar sakta hai. Perp DEX ledger public rakhta hai aur aapko permission maangne ke bajaye request sign karke withdraw karne deta hai. Badle mein aap naye risks lete hain: smart contract bugs, bridge failures, aur sequencer ya validators chalane walon par nirbharta. Koi bhi model market risk khatam nahi karta; DEX yeh badalta hai ki aapko kis par trust karna hai, yeh nahi ki leverage aapko nuksaan pahuncha sakta hai ya nahi.
da8d83b5a6bae363: Har perp trade ko ek counterparty chahiye, aur perp DEXs yeh alag-alag tareekon se dete hain. Order-book venues aapka order doosre traders ke resting orders se match karte hain, bilkul stock exchange ki tarah. Pool-based venues aapko oracle se liye gaye price par ek shared liquidity pool ke against trade karne dete hain, toh pool ke depositors aapke counterparty hote hain. Request-for-quote (RFQ) venues ek market maker se aapke liye price quote karwate hain jise aap accept ya reject kar sakte hain. Kuch venues in sources ko combine karte hain, aur aage ke modules har design ko detail mein dekhte hain.
dbea92508de76d2a: CEX se DEX par jaane se leveraged position ki economics nahi badalti. Aap ab bhi margin post karte hain, ab bhi funding pay ya receive karte hain, aur agar losses aapka collateral kha jaayein toh ab bhi liquidate ho sakte hain. Fees ab bhi hoti hain, haalaanki woh makers, takers, liquidity providers aur protocol ke beech alag tarah se bant sakti hain. On-chain venues kuch operational steps jodte hain jo CEX chhupa leta hai, jaise trade karne se pehle collateral ko sahi chain par bridge karna. In mechanics ko samajhna is course ke har doosre module ki neev hai.

5f494f5855bd4fbe: Margin, leverage, PnL, funding aur liquidation
bed4bda3acf5ce15: Leveraged position ke peeche ke numbers samjhiye: notional size, initial aur maintenance margin, profit aur loss, funding payments aur woh point jahan position liquidate hoti hai.
b9f612b7a9d540dd: Notional size, initial margin aur effective leverage calculate karein
c0e58b4ed884f5f0: Long aur short positions ka profit aur loss compute karein
0efd8f26b9b58dd4: Maintenance margin samjhayein aur batayein ki equity zero hone se pehle liquidation kyun hota hai
f09953094d16347f: Funding payment calculate karein aur batayein kaun si side pay karti hai
a064f728b46d1b4f: Perp trader jo mukhya fees deta hai unki list banayein
6835c8a0b5a718ea: Maximum leverage ke bajaye liquidation distance ke hisaab se position size chunein
545bfbaa797e3bde: Position ki notional value uska size guna price hoti hai, jaise 100 price wale ek hypothetical asset ke 10 contracts ka notional 1,000 hai. Initial margin use kholne ke liye zaroori collateral hai, jo notional bhaag leverage ke barabar hota hai, toh 10x par upar wali position ko 100 margin chahiye. Leverage yeh nahi badalta ki price ke har unit move par aap kitna kamate ya gawate hain; woh sirf size par nirbhar hai. Leverage yeh badalta hai ki position ke peeche kitna kam collateral hai, aur isliye kitna chhota move us collateral ko khatam kar sakta hai. Zyaadatar venues har market ke liye maximum leverage set karte hain, aur riskier ya thinner markets ko kam maximum milta hai.
e160a8d17325fe5f: Long position ke liye profit aur loss (PnL) size guna exit price minus entry price hota hai. Short ke liye yeh size guna entry price minus exit price hai, isliye price girne par shorts kamate hain. Jab tak position open hai, gain ya loss unrealized hota hai aur aam taur par last trade ke bajaye mark price se measure hota hai. Jab aap position close ya kam karte hain, PnL ka woh hissa realized ho jaata hai aur aapke collateral mein credit ya debit hota hai. Pehle wale example mein, 100 se 105 tak 10-contract long 50 kamata hai, jo 100 margin par 50 percent return hai, fees aur funding se pehle.
6c53336c1ffa2273: Aapki account equity aapka collateral plus unrealized PnL hai. Har market mein ek maintenance margin requirement bhi hoti hai, notional ka ek hissa jo position open rehte cover rehna chahiye, aur yeh initial margin se kam hoti hai. Agar equity maintenance requirement se neeche gir jaaye, venue ka liquidation engine position ka kuch ya poora hissa close kar deta hai. Liquidation jaan-boojhkar equity zero hone se pehle hota hai, kyunki bacha hua buffer chalte market mein position close karne ki cost cover karne ke liye hai. Mote taur par, 10x ka long jiski maintenance requirement initial margin ki aadhi hai, lagbhag 5 percent price girne par liquidate hota hai, 10 par nahi.
d9bce9b121006248: Funding payment position ki notional value guna us period ka funding rate hota hai. c55b6d51058be5f8: Proprietary trading ka original matlab tha ki ek bank ya trading house apna paisa in-house traders ke through risk karta tha, jo employees hote the. Ye desks traders ko seedhe hire karte, train karte aur pay karte the, aur zyaadatar upside firm rakhti thi. Modern retail version alag tarah kaam karta hai: online koi bhi fee dekar ek test try kar sakta hai, aur firm unhe kabhi hire nahi karti. Agar aap pass hote hain, toh aapko firm ke rules ke tahat ek account ka access milta hai aur profit ka ek hissa aap rakhte hain. Shabd wahi hai, lekin business model, legal rishta aur risks bahut alag hain.
76b5ce75b1cc6f17: Challenge ek trial account hai jahan aapko bina koi rule tode ek profit target tak pahunchna hota hai. Kuch programs single phase use karte hain, kuch do ya zyaada phases alag targets ke saath, aur kuch mein koi target nahi hota bas trading ka ek minimum period hota hai. Aap aam taur par har attempt ki one-time fee dete hain, aur koi rule todne par attempt turant khatam ho jaata hai, chahe aap profit mein hon. Kai programs unlimited time dete hain jabki kuch deadline set karte hain. Challenge yeh test karne ke liye bana hai ki kya aap risk limits ka respect karte hue paisa bana sakte hain, sirf yeh nahi ki aap paisa bana sakte hain ya nahi.
192feb76dff9d598: Ek important detail jise marketing aksar dhundhla kar deti hai, woh yeh hai ki funded account asal paisa hai bhi ya nahi. Kai programs mein funded account simulated hi rehta hai, aur aapke payouts real market mein kamaye profit se nahi balki firm ke apne revenue se diye jaate hain. Doosri firms trader ki kuch ya saari positions live market mein daalti hain, kabhi-kabhi tabhi jab trader kuch samay tak khud ko prove kar chuka ho. Dono models legitimate ho sakte hain, lekin ye bahut alag incentives aur risks banate hain. Kaunsa model laagu hai, yeh jaanne ki ek hi bharosemand jagah hai firm ki terms, poori padhi hui.
070c895bdde57d8a: Jab funded account paisa banata hai, toh trader ko profit ka ek tay percentage milta hai aur baaki firm rakhti hai. Payouts aam taur par ek fixed cycle par request kiye jaate hain, aksar minimum din ya trades ke baad, aur kai firms withdrawal allow karne se pehle ek minimum profit maangti hain. Kuch programs pehle payout ke saath challenge fee refund kar dete hain. Payout request se aapki trading history ka rules ke against review shuru ho sakta hai. Jo profit abhi tak pay out nahi hua, woh screen par ek number hai, aapke account mein paisa nahi.
4a2ce8c24176c378: Scaling plan tay conditions poori karne ke baad, jaise kai mahino mein ek profit level, aapke account ka size ya profit mein aapka hissa badhata hai. Idea hai consistency ko reward karna, na ki ek lucky hafte ko. Scaling ke saath aam taur par wahi ya aur strict rules aate hain, isliye bada account matlab zyaada azaadi nahi. Conditions dhyaan se padhiye, kyunki kuch plans ek hi breach ke baad progress reset kar dete hain. Scaling ko disciplined trading ka bonus maaniye, extra risk lene ki wajah kabhi nahi.

News rule kisi announcement ke aas-paas ek window mein positions kholna ya band karna mana kar sakta hai, ya bas us dauraan bane profits ko count nahi karta. Weekend rules markets band hone se pehle positions close karne ko keh sakte hain, jo 24 ghante chalne wale crypto markets ke liye kam matter karta hai lekin kai platforms par phir bhi laagu hai. 5709460764c1b9ee: B-booking ka matlab hai ki firm ya uska broker aapke trades real market mein nahi bhejta. Aapki positions internally record hoti hain, aur aapka profit firm ki cost hai jabki aapka loss firm ka fayda. Simulated accounts par chalne wale funded program mein har trader effectively B-booked hota hai. Yeh retail trading mein aam hai aur apne aap mein illegal nahi, lekin isse traders ke haarne mein seedha financial interest banta hai. Aap B-booked hain ya nahi, yeh jaanna un rules ko samajhne mein madad karta hai jo accounts jaldi khatam karne ke liye bane lagte hain.
853aa1b73952ccf9: A-booking ka matlab hai trades real market ya liquidity provider tak pass kiye jaate hain. Tab firm fees, commissions ya profit mein apne hisse se kamati hai, aur jeetne wala trader cost nahi balki achhi khabar hai. Real capital chalane ke liye risk management, funding aur execution venues ke saath rishte chahiye, isliye ise operate karna mehenga hai. Kuch firms khud ko live-capital firm batati hain lekin sirf thode se accounts route karti hain. Poochiye ki routing kaise aur kab hoti hai aur kya yeh terms mein documented hai.

Achanak rule changes, strict payout reviews ya delayed withdrawals strain ke shuruaati sanket ho sakte hain. Market disruptions ya platform problems ke baad firms band hui hain ya pay karna rok diya hai, aur traders ke profits unpaid reh gaye. Ek transparent firm apna model saaf-saaf samjhati hai. Mostly fees se kamane wali firm ke paas payouts tight karne ki wajah hoti hai jab woh sales se tez badhein. Woh decide karti hai ki eligible hote hi profits withdraw karegi, unhe jama hone nahi degi.

dbb84d048432ca7b: Poori terms of service padhiye, pricing page ki summary nahi. Aise clauses par nazar rakhiye jo firm ko apni marzi se payouts deny karne ya accounts band karne dete hain, ya jo prohibited trading ko broad, gol-mol bhasha mein define karte hain. Accounts mein ek hi strategy use karne, shared IP addresses ya devices se trade karne, expert advisors ya copy tools use karne, aur news par positions hold karne ke rules check kijiye. Dekhiye ki kya firm kabhi bhi rules badal sakti hai aur kya changes existing accounts par laagu hote hain. Agar koi key term saaf nahi hai, toh pay karne se pehle likhit mein clarification maangiye.
6754597b0af59b7f: Know Your Customer checks aapki identity verify karte hain, aur kai firms inhe signup par nahi balki sirf funded stage ya pehle payout par maangti hain. Is timing ka matlab hai ki trader pay kar sakta hai, pass ho sakta hai, aur phir pata chale ki apne desh ya documents ki wajah se woh eligible nahi hai. Shuru karne se pehle restricted countries aur zaroori documents ki list padhiye. Sochiye ki firm aapke identity documents kaise store karegi aur kya woh apni data handling samjhati hai. Agar aapka passport galat haathon mein pahunch jaaye toh woh kisi bhi challenge fee se zyaada keemti hai.
0c62baa54c1aae4b: Brand ke peeche ki legal company dhoondhiye, woh kahan registered hai, aur contract par kaunsa kaanoon laagu hota hai. Kai prop firms brokers ya investment firms ki tarah regulated nahi hain, kyunki unka kehna hai ki woh investment services nahi balki evaluations bechti hain, jisse traders ke paas kam protection bachta hai. Check kijiye ki disputes kaise handle hote hain: sirf internal review, arbitration, ya kisi khaas desh ki courts. Jis firm ki koi saaf legal entity na ho, ya jo baar-baar entity names badalti ho, woh aapko bahut kam raasta deti hai. Agar aap samajh hi nahi pa rahe ki case kis par karenge, toh maan lijiye ki aap kar hi nahi paayenge.
47683dfc434ec2ee: Urgency par bane offers se saavdhaan rahiye: hamesha chalne wale countdown timers, lagaataar bade discounts aur aggressive affiliate promotion. Jo waade baaki market ke mukaable bahut generous lagein, unki extra jaanch kijiye, kyunki generosity ka paisa kahin na kahin se aana hi hai. Doosre warning signs mein anjaan processors ke naam par delayed payouts, peeche se laagu kiye gaye rule changes, aur payout request ke baad jawaab dena band karne wala support shaamil hain. Trading platform ya broker ka achanak badalna bhi operational trouble ka sanket ho sakta hai. Ek red flag ek sawaal hai, kai ek saath ek jawaab hain.
d4a090458dca561e: Simulated account mein aapke fills poori tarah firm ke price feed aur execution model par nirbhar karte hain. Spreads, slippage, commissions aur swap ya funding charges real exchange se alag ho sakte hain aur chupchaap ek jeetne wali strategy ko haarne wali bana sakte hain. Ho sake toh volatile periods mein firm ke quotes ki tulna kisi bade market se kijiye. Check kijiye ki platform outages kaise handle karta hai aur outage ke dauraan band hue trades ka fair review hota hai ya nahi. Use pata chalta hai ki firm payout reject kar sakti hai agar use trading real market conditions se inconsistent lage, aur us phrase ko define nahi kiya gaya. Woh support ko email karke poochti hai ki kya uski scalping strategy allowed hai aur jawaab save kar leti hai. Gol-mol clause use rokta nahi, lekin wahan attempts par woh kitna kharch karne ko taiyaar hai, yeh kam kar deta hai.

Ranking percentage return, absolute profit ya trading volume se ho sakti hai, aur yeh choice tay karti hai ki kaunsa behaviour reward hoga. Sirf return se rank hone wali competitions extreme risk ko favour karti hain, kyunki jiske paas khone ko kuch nahi woh top ke liye bada daav laga sakta hai. Host ko activity, fees aur attention se fayda hota hai, isliye prize ek marketing cost hai. Prop challenge ke ulat, yahan aapka apna paisa risk par hai, lekin participate karne ki koi fee nahi.
2cad5a897f7c2a21: Kuch crypto projects smart contracts se prop model dobara banane ki koshish karte hain. Ek typical design mein, liquidity providers ek pool mein capital deposit karte hain, traders ko trading limits allot hoti hain, aur maximum loss jaise risk rules support team ke bajaye code se automatically enforce hote hain. Kuch designs mein traders ko apna collateral lagana padta hai jo pehle losses jhelta hai. Kyunki rules on-chain hain, unhe interpret karne ke bajaye padha aur check kiya ja sakta hai. b61eb6b9a8528e8b: Vaults: ek lead trader ko back karna
08d64d0439b77bab: Vault ek lead trader ya strategy ke control mein deposits ko pool karta hai. Misaal ke taur par Hyperliquid par, vault leader pooled funds trade karta hai, depositors vault mein apne hisse ke anupaat mein profits aur losses share karte hain, aur leader ko profits ka ek hissa milta hai. Yeh structure prop model ko ulat deta hai: trader ko company nahi balki depositors fund karte hain, aur investment risk depositor leta hai. Positions aur performance on-chain dikhte hain, isliye depositors dekh sakte hain ki leader kya kar raha hai. Phir bhi depositors poori tarah leader ke judgment par nirbhar rehte hain.
ee0d50f0a5ad78f3: Copy trading ek follower ko doosre trader ki positions apne account mein automatically mirror karne deti hai, chahe centralised exchange par ya on-chain tools se. Lead trader ko aam taur par followers ke profits ka ek hissa milta hai. Followers ko leader se kharab prices mil sakti hain, khaaskar tez markets ya patli order books mein, kyunki unke orders baad mein pahunchte hain. Leaderboard par past performance luck ya chhupe risk ka nateeja ho sakti hai, jaise badi, shayad hi kabhi stop hone wali losing positions. Public track record ko analysis ka starting point maaniye, guarantee nahi.
077dce82e96b7c9c: Crypto-native models mein sabse bada structural badlaav visibility hai. On-chain vaults aur contracts balances, trades aur rule enforcement public records mein dikhate hain, jabki off-chain prop firm aapse apne internal systems par bharosa karne ko kehti hai. Yeh transparency losses chhupana ya chupchaap rules badalna mushkil banati hai. Yeh kharab strategy, contract bug ya market crash ka risk khatam nahi karti. Transparency aapko check karne deti hai, lekin dekhna aapko hi padega.
0cba039dce06035b: Vaults aur on-chain programs mein smart contract risk, oracle risk aur tez market mein liquidation ka risk hota hai. Vault mein withdrawal conditions bhi ho sakti hain, jaise delays ya lockups, jo stress ke samay matter karti hain. Leaders apna behaviour badal sakte hain, losing streak ke baad zyaada leverage le sakte hain, ya bas achhe se manage karna band kar sakte hain. High-risk incentives wali competitions aisi aadatein bana sakti hain jo disciplined prop challenge mein fail ho jaatein. Koi bhi exposure utna hi rakhiye jitna paisa aap kho sakte hain.
42a049bb23af98b8: Ek event jahan traders ranking metric par aadharit prizes ke liye apne capital se compete karte hain.
74f8e944b00a98dc: Deposit kiye gaye funds ka pool jise lead trader ya strategy manage karti hai, profits aur losses pro rata share hote hain.
297e6974eea3a1c2: Woh trader jo vault ki positions control karta hai aur jise aam taur par uske profits ka ek hissa milta hai.
25965c2374b7690d: Doosre trader ki positions ko apne account mein automatically mirror karna.
07974335bed542bd: Trader ka lagaya capital jo kisi aur ke funds par asar padne se pehle losses jhelta hai.

d8002a939a434c07: Ek trader ek perpetual exchange par ek vault mein deposit karne ki soch rahi hai. Sirf headline return dekhne ke bajaye, woh leader ki open positions, sabse bada historical drawdown aur losing periods ke baad leverage kaise badla, yeh review karti hai. Use dikhta hai ki leader ne recover hone se pehle hafton tak ek losing position mein average down kiya. Woh tay karti hai ki strong return ke saath chhupa tail risk tha aur bas thodi si raqam deposit karti hai, agar karti bhi hai.

7b6b0639bba2d3b3: Evaluation pass karna zyaadatar ek risk problem hai: floor hit karne se pehle aapko target tak pahunchna hai. Drawdown buffer ke hisaab se positions size karna aur apni expectancy jaanna ek jua ko plan mein badal deta hai.
4b5a86a4b59d979d: Win rate aur average win aur loss se expectancy calculate kijiye
635603a1f87a7894: Positions ko bache hue drawdown buffer ke ek hisse ke roop mein size kijiye
b32feccabb9b0f34: Andaaza lagaiye ki account lagaataar kitne losses jhel sakta hai

e507155e69ec2f7a: Expectancy woh average raqam hai jo aap har trade par jeetne ya haarne ki ummeed karte hain, jise win rate guna average win minus loss rate guna average loss se calculate karte hain. Positive expectancy wali strategy kai trades mein paisa banati hai, jabki negative wali chahe kaise bhi size ho, haarti hai. Ise memory ya kuch wins se nahi, balki apne journaled trades ke ek theek-thaak sample se measure kijiye. Results ko R mein, yaani har trade par risk ki gayi raqam mein, express karne se expectancy alag position sizes mein comparable ban jaati hai. Agar aap apni expectancy nahi jaante, toh challenge skill ka nahi, luck ka test hai.
5d748fcc7c90ca53: Drawdown buffer ke hisaab se sizing
46b5868a98952e79: Drawdown buffer aapki current equity aur us level ke beech ki doori hai jo account khatam kar deta hai. Nominal account ke percentage ke roop mein size karne ke bajaye, us buffer ke ek chhote hisse ke roop mein size kijiye. Misaal ke liye, agar ek hypothetical account fail hone se pehle 10 percent kho sakta hai aur aap har trade par 1 percent risk karte hain, toh lagaataar das losses use khatam kar dete hain. Har trade par 0.5 percent risk karne se yeh number double ho jaata hai. Har trade par kam risk se target mein zyaada samay lagta hai lekin wahan pahunchne ka chance kaafi badh jaata hai.
c5dcf63f603ad5e5: Profitable strategy bhi losses ki streaks paida karti hai, aur aap jitna lamba trade karenge, utni lambi worst streak dekhenge. Aadhe time jeetne wali strategy kuch sau trades mein baar-baar paanch ya zyaada losses ke runs degi. Aapki sizing ko woh streak jhelni chahiye jo aapki strategy realistically paida kar sakti hai, na ki woh jiski aap ummeed karte hain. Challenge se pehle numbers nikaliye: aapke chune hue risk par lagaataar kitne losses account khatam kar dete hain? Agar jawaab chintajanak roop se chhota hai, toh risk kam kijiye.
b2e2fa0306dc3f40: Firm ki limits ke andar personal limits
824b78f0832343ea: Firm ki daily loss limit se kaafi andar ek personal daily stop set kijiye, taaki ek bura din kabhi jaanleva na ho. Ek common tareeka hai tay number of losing trades ya R mein tay loss ke baad rukk jaana, jo pehle aaye. Slippage ke liye aur un open positions ke liye jagah chhodiye jo aapka stop fill hone se pehle aapke khilaaf chalti hain. Trailing drawdown mein, equity badhne par profit lock kijiye ya size kam kijiye, kyunki floor bhi saath mein upar uthta hai. Aapki limits aisi hon ki firm ke rules aapke rozana decisions ke liye lagbhag irrelevant ho jaayein.
10a23ec3b0de5191: Ek achha evaluation plan un markets ko list karta hai jo aap trade karte hain, jo setups aap lete hain, har trade par aapka risk, aapka daily stop, aur woh samay jab aap trade nahi karenge, jaise restricted news events ke aas-paas. Ismein ek pre-trade checklist hoti hai jo entry se pehle setup, stop aur position size confirm karti hai. Har trade entry ki wajah, R mein result aur jis rule ko todne ke aap kareeb aaye, uske saath journal hota hai. Ek weekly review results ki tulna aapki expected expectancy se karta hai. Plan isliye hai taaki pressure mein liye jaane wale decisions pehle hi shaanti se liye ja chuke hon.
73cc0055960f9668: Pressure points: target ke kareeb aur losses ke baad
780778b77e2a5b27: Do pal zyaadatar plans tod dete hain: target ke kareeb hona aur drawdown mein hona. Target ke kareeb, traders aksar jaldi khatam karne ke liye size badha dete hain, jo lagbhag pass account ko failed bana deta hai. Losses ke baad, wapas jeetne ki chaah oversized trades karwati hai jo loss limit hit kar dete hain. d83fcd0ab21e9427: Classical computer information ko bits mein store karta hai, aur har bit ya toh 0 hota hai ya 1. Quantum computer qubits use karta hai, jo trapped ions, superconducting circuits ya photons jaisi cheezon se banaye ja sakte hain. Qubit ki state do numbers se describe hoti hai jinhe amplitudes kehte hain, ek 0 se juda aur ek 1 se. Yeh amplitudes positive, negative ya complex numbers bhi ho sakte hain, jo ordinary probabilities kabhi nahi ho saktin. Yahi extra structure quantum algorithms exploit karte hain.
b57b83480b276591: Superposition mein qubit ke 0 aur 1 dono ke liye ek hi time par nonzero amplitudes hote hain. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki qubit chupke se 0 ya 1 hai aur humein bas pata nahi. State ek genuine combination hai, aur qubit par operations dono amplitudes par saath mein act karte hain. n qubits ke group ko 2 to the power n amplitudes describe karte hain, isliye qubits badhne par description exponentially badhti hai. Isi wajah se classical computer par bahut saare qubits simulate karna jaldi hi infeasible ho jaata hai.
f75fb41c76b770d8: Jab aap qubit measure karte hain, toh aapko uske amplitudes nahi dikhte. Aapko ek single result milta hai, 0 ya 1, jiski probabilities amplitudes tay karte hain, aur superposition khatam ho jaata hai. n qubits measure karne par aapko sirf n ordinary bits milte hain, unke peeche ke 2 to the power n amplitudes nahi. Yahi quantum computing ki sabse crucial limit hai. Quantum algorithm ko cheezein aise arrange karni padti hain ki measure karte waqt useful answer aane ke chances bahut zyada hon.
d55ff12de274d07a: Ek popular myth kehta hai ki quantum computers har possible answer ek saath try karke sahi wala chun lete hain. Aisa kaam nahi hota, kyunki measurement bas ek random possibility return karega. Iski jagah quantum algorithms interference use karte hain: amplitudes waves ki tarah jud sakte hain ya cancel ho sakte hain. Achha design kiya algorithm galat answers ke amplitudes cancel karwata hai aur sahi answers ke amplitudes ko strong banata hai. Sirf sahi mathematical structure wali problems mein hi yeh trick achhe se kaam karti hai.
0ede6d488de905de: Entanglement qubits ke beech ek aisa link hai jismein group ki state ko har qubit ki alag state dekar describe nahi kiya ja sakta. Jab entangled qubits measure hote hain, toh unke results aise correlated hote hain jinhe independent parts wali koi classical explanation reproduce nahi kar sakti. Yeh correlations Bell tests naam ke experiments mein confirm ho chuke hain. Entanglement se light se tez message nahi bheja ja sakta, kyunki har individual result akele mein random hi dikhta hai. Computation mein entanglement ek resource hai jisse quantum algorithms apna zaroori structured interference bana paate hain.
4adf933ebca1f9f2: Qubits apne environment ke liye bahut sensitive hote hain, aur thodi si heat, vibration ya electromagnetic noise bhi unhe disturb kar sakti hai. Quantum behavior ke is loss ko decoherence kehte hain, aur isse calculations mein errors aate hain. Quantum error correction ek reliable logical qubit ko bahut saare physical qubits mein spread karta hai taaki errors detect aur fix ho sakein. Cryptography ko khatra dene wale lambe algorithms chalane ke liye bahut saare logical qubits chahiye, aur isliye physical qubits toh kahin zyada. Aaj ke noisy devices aur fault-tolerant machines ke beech ka yeh gap hi wajah hai ki sirf physical qubits ginna cryptographic risk ke baare mein kam batata hai.

Kyunki capable quantum computer kab aa sakta hai iske estimates bahut alag hain, lambe migration lead times hi jaldi shuru karne ka main argument hain.
